name: identity_external_identities
description: A link between a Person and one stable external account (PDT Connect identitySubject or Sankhya CODUSU) under a fixed issuer, created from a server-verified proof by the account holder or by an owner selecting the account in the Sankhya directory.
lifecycle: Removed explicitly by the Person (recent authentication, never the last sign-in method) or an owner, with an audit event. Cascades only if a Person were deleted, which the application never does.

columns.Meaning: Immutable link UUID used to address removal.
pdt or sankhya; selects the connector that proved the identity.
Fixed provider installation identifier from server configuration (PDT_IDENTITY_ISSUER or SANKHYA_IDENTITY_ISSUER); never taken from browser input.
Stable provider subject: PDT identitySubject UUID or Sankhya CODUSU. Never a name or e-mail.
Display snapshot of the provider account name at last verification; informational only.
columns.Null meaning: The provider supplied no display name.

columns.Meaning: Normalized e-mail reported by the provider for this account. Used only as a hint to ask for proof before provisioning a second Person; never as proof or merge criterion.
proof: the account holder proved the account to IA-MNS; directory: an owner selected and attested the account from the Sankhya directory, validated server-side.
Owner who attested a directory link.
columns.Null meaning: Established by the account holder's proof.

columns.Meaning: Database-clock instant the link was proven and created.
Application-clock instant of the latest successful proof through this link.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK ((((established_by)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['proof'::character varying, 'directory'::character varying])::text[])) AND (((established_by)::text = 'proof'::text) OR (linked_by IS NOT NULL))))
constraints.Purpose: Known establishment kinds; directory links name the attesting owner.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (person_id) REFERENCES identity_persons(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE CASCADE
CREATE INDEX identity_external_identities_email_idx ON public.identity_external_identities USING btree (email)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_external_identities_person_provider_key ON public.identity_external_identities USING btree (person_id, provider, issuer)
constraints.Purpose: A Person has at most one account per provider installation.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX identity_external_identities_subject_key ON public.identity_external_identities USING btree (provider, issuer, subject)
constraints.Purpose: One external account maps to at most one Person; no silent duplication or merge.
